verdict.rationale: A state business-filing registry could plausibly offer programmatic event notifications, such as filing-status or annual-report webhooks, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Electronic AR Reminder and GovDelivery subscription are human-facing notification services, not webhooks. Probes also found no public API or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
